**Historian's response on the hulpslag, approval, and cables**

**(a) Approver and register entries for ENG-105 and ENG-010:** My archive does not hold these IDs. Neither ENG-105 nor ENG-010 appears in my source, so I cannot confirm the approval wording, the approver, or the 16:45 proefopstelling. My source also has no record of a hulpslag activation at all. The nearest day-9 entries are HIS-032 (kist oude inkt besteld, dag 9 12:25) and HIS-033 (proefblad oude en nieuwe inkt, dag 9 17:10). Both concern ink, not the datanet.

**(b) Earlier activations, or Desync-like events:**
- No earlier hulpslag activation is recorded.
- Day 10 events that match the Engineer's timeline: HIS-035, "de Burchtader stokte even, gemeld door de nachtwake" (gebeurd dag 10 04:45, vastgelegd dag 10 07:20). HIS-036, "klacht uit de benedenstad: berichten half aangekomen" (gebeurd dag 10 04:50).
- Integrity problem: HIS-036 was vastgelegd dag 9 23:55, before it gebeurd at dag 10 04:50. HIS-053 (lek bij poort oost, 3 minuten, gebeurd dag 22 04:15) was vastgelegd dag 22 01:50, also before the event. HIS-103 states that vastgelegd always equals gebeurd, so these two records break the archive's own rule. HIS-112 and HIS-116 record clerks' complaints about day-10 and day-22 timestamps, which were treated as clerical errors. I have not verified that explanation against the originals.
- Earlier analogues: HIS-003 and HIS-004 record the Stille Winter (212 years ago), which began in one night and lasted 40 days. That predates the datanet, so it is not a hulpslag precedent. HIS-106 records no hapering of the leylijnen in 23 years of datanet.
- HIS-114 is my own 19th-day interpretation linking the Stille Winter to day 10. It is not a register fact, and I withdraw it as evidence.
- I have no throughput or packet-loss measurements in my source.

**(c) Forest cables:** ENG-003 is not in my source, so I cannot confirm that ID. The substance is confirmed by my records. HIS-005 and HIS-007 record that the woudkabels were laid 23 years ago. HIS-105 states they "zijn sindsdien niet gewijzigd; het register kent geen verlegging en geen vervanging." HIS-014 (dag 3 08:30) records an inspection with "niets gewijzigd." The Beast Master's claim of new cables is therefore contradicted by my archive. HIS-046 (houtkap in het dal, dag 16) is the only woud entry after day 3, and it records no cable work.
